acceptance: Terminal/editor adapters pass input, resize, selection, unicode and lifecycle fixtures; lazy modules do not load on unrelated pages.

positive.fixture: lazy loading (plain page fetches no adapter chunk; each adapter fetches only its own), 14 terminal and 8 editor scenarios in Chromium: keys, paste, bracketed paste, IME composition, resize and fit, selection, focus, wide/combining/astral text, split and invalid UTF-8, dispose
positive.command: pnpm --filter @vsf/specialized-tests exec playwright test specs/lazy.spec.ts specs/terminal.spec.ts specs/editor.spec.ts

negative.fixture: bad sizes and ranges refused, use after dispose refused, hostile escape sequences cannot retitle or navigate, read-only refuses edits, a failed chunk load rejects and recovers on reload
negative.command: pnpm --filter @vsf/specialized-tests exec playwright test specs/terminal.spec.ts specs/editor.spec.ts specs/lazy.spec.ts -g refused|cannot retitle|failed library|disposing|read-only

versions.primitive: none; new package @vsf/specialized and CI job specialized

security_and_source_permissions: xterm and CodeMirror are exact-pinned MIT packages at least two weeks old; terminal output has no link, title or clipboard handler; the terminal's replies to status queries arrive through onInput and are not user typing.
performance_memory_storage: Entry 9.5 KB; terminal chunk 437 KB and editor chunk 581 KB load only when used; 40 open and dispose cycles grow the heap about 0.9 MB.
